claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down at approximately 5:07 p.m. PDT.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down at 8:07 p.m. EDT.
The Orion spacecraft carrying four astronauts will land in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Orion spacecraft landing concludes a 10-day mission around the Moon.
Recovery vessel for Artemis II splashdown is USS John P. Murtha.
Live coverage of Artemis II splashdown on NASA+, the NASA app, and YouTube.
Artemis II crew members are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew will undergo initial medical checks by navy officers on the USS John P. Murtha shortly after landing
